# runpod_machine (Resource)

A host machine listed on Runpod. Deprecated: Machines have no REST v2 route yet; this calls the GraphQL API and will be removed when a /v2/machines surface exists. Only name and bid_price_per_gpu are settable, because the create mutation takes no other input; every other attribute reports what the API assigned.

**If you are an AI agent:** set up through https://agents.runpod.io first, then follow
[Using the provider from an AI agent](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/runpod/runpod/latest/docs/guides/agent-setup) before you plan or apply.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Deprecated GraphQL shim; removed when REST v2 has a machines route.

resource "runpod_machine" "rig" {
  name = "rig-01"
}
```

Complete, runnable configurations that use this resource live in the
[use-case modules](https://github.com/runpod/terraform-provider-runpod/tree/main/v2/modules);
the Guides section documents each one.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `bid_price_per_gpu` (Number) Bid price per GPU in USD/hr. Write-only in 1.x and absent from every GraphQL document, so it reports back what was configured.
- `name` (String) Machine name. The only attribute the API accepts on create, and the only one an update changes.

### Read-Only

- `cpu_count` (Number) Number of CPU cores.
- `data_center_id` (String) Data center the machine belongs to.
- `disk_in_gb` (Number) Installed disk in GB (diskTotal).
- `gpu_count` (Number) Number of GPUs installed in the machine (gpuTotal).
- `gpu_type_id` (String) GPU type identifier of the GPUs installed in the machine.
- `host_price_per_gpu` (Number) Host price per GPU in USD/hr.
- `id` (String) Machine identifier assigned by the API.
- `listed` (Boolean) Whether the machine is listed for others to rent.
- `location` (String) Location or country code the machine sits in.
- `maintenance_mode` (Boolean) Whether the machine is in maintenance mode.
- `memory_in_gb` (Number) Installed memory in GB (memoryTotal).
- `runpod_ip` (String) Machine IP address as Runpod sees it.
- `secure_cloud` (Boolean) Whether the machine runs in secure cloud.
- `verified` (Boolean) Whether the machine is verified.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Machines are imported by machine id.
terraform import runpod_machine.rig m4h2k9qzx1
```
